data.name: Rival Soldier Front
data.detailed_description:
Rival Soldier Front

Rival Soldier Front is a high-intensity, online multiplayer first-person shooter that delivers fast-paced action, tactical combat, and a rich arsenal of realistic weaponry. Set in modern military environments across the globe, the game challenges players to outthink, outgun, and outmaneuver their enemies in a variety of objective-based missions and classic competitive modes.

Key Features

🪖 Elite Soldier Classes
Choose from a range of specialized soldier classes—Assault, Sniper, Support, Engineer, and more—each with unique loadouts, strengths, and abilities that promote team synergy and tactical gameplay.

🎯 Core Game Modes

  • Team Deathmatch – Jump into quick, intense firefights where reflexes and precision matter most.

  • Team Battle – Coordinate with your squad to achieve mission objectives in strategic, round-based combat.

  • Elimination & Survival Modes – For players who prefer high-stakes, single-life rounds and hardcore endurance matches.

🔫 Authentic Weapon Systems
Unlock and customize a wide selection of realistic military firearms and gear. Weapon handling emphasizes recoil control, reload timing, and situational awareness to reward skillful play.

🗺️ Diverse Real-World Inspired Maps
Battle across tightly-designed maps set in urban warzones, military compounds, and hostile wilderness regions. Each map supports different playstyles and tactics—from close-quarters combat to long-range engagements.

 Progression & Customization
Climb the ranks by earning XP from matches, completing missions, and mastering weapons. Unlock new equipment, cosmetics, and character skins to personalize your soldier and showcase your achievements.

 Competitive and Community-Driven
Ranked matchmaking ensures balanced games based on skill level, while regular seasonal events and challenges offer fresh content and rewards for the community.

Immersive Audio and Soundtrack
Realistic sound design keeps you aware of enemy movements and environmental cues, while a cinematic soundtrack amplifies the intensity of each battle.

 Nostalgic Feel, Modern Mechanics
Rival SF captures the adrenaline-fueled action of classic shooters, updated with modern controls, refined gunplay, and a polished UI. Whether you're a veteran of old-school FPS games or new to the genre, Rival Soldier Front offers a deep yet accessible competitive experience.

Estimated Playtime

With multiple classes to master, dozens of weapons to unlock, and an ever-evolving set of modes and maps, Rival Soldier Front offers hundreds of hours of replayable content, both casually and competitively.

data.short_description: Rival Soldier Front is a tactical online first-person shooter where players engage in fast-paced team battles using real-world weapons, specialized soldier classes, and skill-based mechanics across competitive game modes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Pentium Dual-Core 2.6 GHz or Equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600 GT / ATI Radeon HD 4650
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with surround support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 - 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 370 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 7 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with surround support
